g.text: Candidate patch bcc2ada9 · no baseline timing comparison
CPUs 2–6 · powersave · shared host · parser in memory · RAW controls on warm Btrfs
3 runs/case · 30 flat samples · 0.3 s warmup · 2 s target
In-memory parse, allocations and drop included · oversize is an early length guard · no backing I/O.
